description: Rewrite admin users management page (src/app/admin/users/page.tsx) with full pagination, debounced search, API-driven filters, and proper CRUD operations. Add pagination controls (page buttons, per-page selector showing 20/50/100 options). Add debounced search (300ms delay) that sends search param to API. Wire filter tabs (All/VIP/Admin/Free) to API query params (subscribed=true for VIP, role=admin for Admin, no filters for All). Fix broken toggleStatus call - await the promise properly and reload data after. Add loading skeletons (5-row table skeleton). Add error state with retry button. Add confirmation dialogs before delete. Ensure all API calls use the new paginated adminService.getUsers(filters).
steps: 1. In src/app/admin/users/page.tsx, add state for: currentPage (number, default 1), perPage (number, default 20), totalPages (number, default 1), metaTotal (number, default 0).

2. Rewrite loadUsers() to accept no args. Build filters object from searchQuery, filterTab, currentPage, perPage. Map filterTab to API params: 'vip' → { subscribed: true }, 'admin' → { role: 'admin' }, 'free' → {} but client-side filter subscribed=false after load (API may not support subscribed=false param). Call adminService.getUsers(filters). Extract users and meta. Set usersList, metaTotal=meta.total, totalPages=meta.last_page. Set loadingUsers=false.
3. Add useEffect that calls loadUsers() whenever currentPage, perPage, searchQuery, or filterTab changes.

4. Replace searchQuery onChange to use debounced handler: import useState + useEffect to create a 300ms debounced effect. When user types, update local input value immediately, but only update searchQuery state (which triggers API call) after 300ms of no typing.

5. Add pagination controls below the table: show 'Page X of Y' label, Previous/Next buttons (disabled when on first/last page), and page number buttons for nearby pages (e.g. show pages currentPage-2 to currentPage+2, with ... ellipsis for gaps).
6. Add per-page selector: dropdown with options 20, 50, 100. On change, set perPage state and reset currentPage to 1.
7. Fix handleToggleVip to await adminService.toggleStatus(u.id), check if result is not null, then call loadUsers(). Show error toast if result is null.

8. Fix the inline suspend/activate button: change the onClick from `adminService.toggleStatus(u.id) && loadUsers()` to `async () => { const res = await adminService.toggleStatus(u.id); if (res) { loadUsers(); showToast(res.status === 'active' ? 'User activated' : 'User suspended') } else { showToast('Failed to toggle status', 'error') } }`.
9. Add loading skeleton: when loadingUsers=true, render 5 empty table rows with pulsing placeholders matching the table column structure (avatar circle, text lines, badge shapes).

10. Add error state: add errorMsg state (string | null). In loadUsers(), catch errors and set errorMsg. When errorMsg is set, show error banner above the table with retry button that clears errorMsg and calls loadUsers().
11. Update handleDelete to show confirmation dialog with window.confirm before calling adminService.deleteUser. If deleteUser returns false, show error toast.
12. Update filter tab click handlers to reset currentPage to 1 when changing tabs (so user doesn't land on page 5 of a different filter that only has 2 pages).
13. Update 'Showing X of Y users' footer text: change from 'Showing {filtered.length} of {totalCount}' to 'Showing {usersList.length} of {metaTotal} users (Page {currentPage} of {totalPages})'.
14. Remove useMemo for filtered list - no client-side filtering. API returns filtered/paginated data directly.

15. For the 'Free' filter tab: since API may not support subscribed=false, fetch all users (no filter) and client-side filter after, OR remove Free tab and only show All/VIP/Admin. Document the choice in a code comment.

16. Update stats counts at top (totalCount, vipCount, adminCount) to be derived from metaTotal when filterTab='all', otherwise show '...' or fetch separate counts via 3 additional API calls with per_page=1 (same pattern as FEAT-002 dashboard).
acceptance_criteria: Users table shows paginated results with page controls (Previous, page numbers, Next)
Per-page dropdown (20/50/100) works and resets to page 1
Search input has 300ms debounce - typing doesn't immediately fire API calls, only after user stops typing
Filter tabs (All/VIP/Admin/Free) send correct query params to API
Suspend/Activate button properly awaits toggleStatus and reloads users on success
Delete shows confirmation dialog and prevents deletion of super admin
Loading skeleton (5 rows) appears while fetching
Error banner with retry button appears on API failure
Pagination state resets to page 1 when changing filters or search query
Footer shows 'Showing X of Y (Page N of M)' with real API totals
verification: npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3001/admin/users
Test pagination: click Next, page numbers, Previous - verify API calls include ?page=N&per_page=20
Test per-page selector: change from 20 to 50 - verify API call includes per_page=50 and page resets to 1
Test search: type 'test', wait 300ms, verify API call includes search=test in Network tab
Test filters: click VIP tab - verify API call includes subscribed=true. Click Admin tab - verify role=admin
Test suspend/activate: click button, verify user status changes in UI and API POST /admin/users/{id}/suspend or /activate is called
Test delete: click delete on non-super-admin user, confirm dialog, verify DELETE /admin/users/{id} is called and user disappears from list
Test loading: throttle network in DevTools, verify 5-row skeleton appears while loading
Test error: break API temporarily (change baseURL in api.ts), verify error banner with retry button appears
